contracts.boundary: Report a stored provider credential that cannot be resolved, warn when a proposed tier routes to it, and keep the advisory candidate writable.
contracts.assertions: A fake registry whose provider status says configured but whose credential resolution throws produces an invalid sign-in report, a check warning on the referencing tier, and a repeated warning in the approval summary while check stays ok and write eligible. A provider that resolves cleanly emits no warning. Provider error text is flattened, stripped of terminal escapes, and bounded before it reaches the model-facing report.

boundaryTest.name: reports a stored sign-in that cannot be resolved and warns without blocking the write

invariant.name: warns only for providers a tier can actually select

fault.name: fault control: a provider that resolves cleanly emits no sign-in warning

contracts.boundary: The snapshot parser defers the line wrap until the next printable character, so a padded TUI frame keeps its row alignment across redraws.
contracts.assertions: Replaying frames through the real Screen class keeps a padded row's successor anchored and leaves no blank row between them. The eager-wrap fault model on the same fixture loses the anchor, and the previous implementation fails both behavioral cases.

boundaryTest.name: defers the wrap at the terminal edge

invariant.name: keeps a padded frame anchored across redraws

fault.name: fault control: an eager wrap moves the anchored row
